arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS cards_with_same_timestamp_pair FROM (SELECT card_id, date FROM transactions GROUP BY card_id, date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS dup
arguments.explanation: Counts the cards that have at least one pair of transactions sharing the exact same date and time.
assumptions: 'Exactly the same timestamp' means an identical date value down to the second in transactions.date.
All transactions are included regardless of amount, merchant, transaction type, errors, or whether they have a fraud label.
Transactions with negative amounts are included as ordinary transactions.
